next_steps: Step 1: Set up a test review request email sequence in Yotpo to ensure it integrates seamlessly with Lucy & Yak's Shopify store and sends reviews to the correct email address.
Step 2: Configure the review collection settings to align with Lucy & Yak's brand guidelines, including customising the review request email template and setting up any necessary workflows.

Step 3: Launch a targeted marketing campaign to encourage customers to leave reviews on Yotpo, focusing on incentivising high-quality content that showcases Lucy & Yak's products in real-life scenarios.

Judge.me's lightweight and budget-friendly approach aligns with Lucy & Yak's need for a cost-effective review collection solution.
